mapper.sql: a.audit_id, a.actor_id AS operator_user_id, coalesce(nullif(u.user_name, ''), a.actor_name) AS username, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), a.actor_name) AS operator_name, a.business_module, a.operation_type, a.object_type AS target_type, a.object_id AS target_id, a.target_name, a.description, a.client_ip AS ip_address, a.status, a.create_time AS operation_time

a.audit_id, a.actor_id AS operator_user_id, coalesce(nullif(u.user_name, ''), a.actor_name) AS username, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), a.actor_name) AS operator_name, a.business_module, a.operation_type, a.object_type AS target_type, a.object_id AS target_id, a.target_name, a.description, a.client_ip AS ip_address, a.status, a.create_time AS operation_time, a.before_json AS before_content, a.after_json AS after_content, a.error_message, a.trace_id
mapper.insert: insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_audit_log`( tenant_id, member_id, actor_id, actor_name, actor_type, action_code, business_module, operation_type, object_type, object_id, target_name, description, before_json, after_json, sensitive_flag, client_ip, status, error_message, trace_id, create_time, is_delete ) values ( #{record.tenantId}, #{record.memberId}, #{record.operatorUserId}, coalesce(#{record.operatorName}, ''), 'merchant_user', concat('merchant.', lower(coalesce(#{record.operationType}, 'business'))), coalesce(#{record.businessModule}, ''), coalesce(#{record.operationType}, ''), coalesce(#{record.targetType}, ''), substring(coalesce(#{record.targetId}, ''), 1, 64), coalesce(#{record.targetName}, ''), coalesce(#{record.description}, ''), nullif(#{record.beforeContent}, ''), nullif(#{record.afterContent}, ''), 0, substring(coalesce(#{record.ipAddress}, ''), 1, 128), coalesce(#{record.status}, 0), coalesce(#{record.errorMessage}, ''), coalesce(#{record.traceId}, ''), now(), 0 )
mapper.select: select from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_audit_log` a left join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` u on u.merchant_user_id = a.actor_id and u.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and u.member_id = a.member_id and u.is_delete = 0 where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.actor_type = 'merchant_user' and a.audit_id = #{auditId} and a.is_delete = 0

select distinct a.business_module from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_audit_log` a where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.actor_type = 'merchant_user' and a.is_delete = 0 and a.business_module is not null and a.business_module != '' order by a.business_module

select distinct coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), a.actor_name) from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_audit_log` a left join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` u on u.merchant_user_id = a.actor_id and u.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and u.member_id = a.member_id and u.is_delete = 0 where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.actor_type = 'merchant_user' and a.is_delete = 0 and coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), a.actor_name) != '' order by coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), a.actor_name)
